test.fill_query: INSERT INTO FUNCTION file('test_parquet_prewhere_dictionary_encoded.parquet', Parquet) SELECT number AS k, toUInt16(cityHash64(number) % 300) AS a, toUInt8(intDiv(number, 500) % 7) AS r, concat('v', toString(cityHash64(number, 1) % 1000)) AS s FROM numbers(50000000) SETTINGS output_format_parquet_write_page_index = 0
test.query: SELECT sum(a), sum(r), max(s) FROM file('test_parquet_prewhere_dictionary_encoded.parquet', Parquet) PREWHERE k % 3 = 0 FORMAT Null
